_comment_redirects: Replicates Vercel dashboard apex->www auto-redirect, but EXCLUDES the /.well-known/* path so the assetlinks.json (Android App Links) and apple-app-site-association (iOS Universal Links) files are reachable on the apex domain WITHOUT following a redirect. Both verifiers fail when their .well-known file lives behind a 301/307. After deploying this file, disable the dashboard auto-redirect (Settings -> Domains -> lootscout.io -> set to No Redirect / Serve as Production) so these rules are the only thing in front of apex traffic.
